duration.text: The Chinese language program at Nanjing University of Science and Technology is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: （1）Valid passport information page. (2) Final diploma and official transcripts (original documents in languages other than Chinese and English must be accompanied by a notarized Chinese or English translation). (3) "Foreigner Physical Examination Form" (4) Certificate of No Criminal Record. (Payment voucher for application fee (500 yuan or 80 US dollars))

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be physically and mentally healthy, abide by Chinese laws and the school's regulations and rules, and respect Chinese customs and habits. 2. Applicants must be at least 18 years old and hold a foreign passport. 3. Obtain a high school graduation certificate or an equivalent academic qualification.
